title: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A Gateless young woman born to the Gruul Clans whose innate magic makes her seem insignificant, so most people cannot notice her; she narrates this story and guides Kaya and Teyo.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate, a ghost-assassin who can go incorporeal, tasked with bringing the guilds to the table for Operation Desperation.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A shield mage from the desert world of Gobakhan who travels with Kaya and Rat and can also see Rat.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker elf who speaks little, can ask trees to attack, and awakened Vitu-Ghazi; the Selesnya blame her and she leaves to join Gideon.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker and Izzet guildmaster who drained the Beacon and devised Operation Desperation; at first he cannot see Rat.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who has lost the powers of the Living Guildpact; he helped assign the guild-recruiting tasks.

entities.name: Boruvo
entities.description: A Selesnya centaur spearmaster, once Gruul, who is Rat's godfather and Keeper of her Life Pledge; he can see Rat.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: An elven champion and acting guildmaster of Selesnya who struggles to keep the guild together in Trostani's absence.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The dormant dryad guildmaster of Selesnya with three identities (Cim, Oba and Ses) growing from a single trunk; Cim wakes and restores her harmony.

entities.name: Cim
entities.description: The central dryad of Trostani, the dryad of Harmony, who has been asleep for months and wakes to reconcile her sisters.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The left dryad of Trostani, the dryad of Life, who cries during Cim's sleep and appeals to Ses.

entities.name: Ses
entities.description: The right dryad of Trostani, the dryad of Order, who is at odds with her sisters until she acquiesces.

entities.name: Ari Shokta
entities.description: Rat's mother, a heavily armed Gruul warrior who can see Rat and gives her bear hugs.

entities.name: Gan Shokta
entities.description: Rat's father, a Gruul leader who can see her only when paying attention; he is fighting Borborygmos when Rat arrives.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: A cyclops and leader of the Gruul Clans who holds Kaya and Teyo responsible for his fall and who is won over by Rat.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A Rakdos friend of Rat who asked her to track Ral Zarek; she is dead as of this story.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari guildmaster who returns to Ravnica, reclaims her throne, accepts the task of helping and petrifies the Eternals blocking the escape.

entities.name: Storrev
entities.description: An undead Golgari lich sorceress, one of Vraska's Erstwhile, who welcomes Ral and Kaya to Svogthos.

entities.name: Azdomas
entities.description: A kraul Krunstraz warrior of the Golgari who reports that Mazirek was a Bolas collaborator.

entities.name: Matka Izoni
entities.description: A devkarin Golgari leader with a claim to Vraska's throne.

entities.name: Varolz
entities.description: A fungal-hided troll of the Golgari with a claim to Vraska's throne.

entities.name: Cevraya
entities.description: An elf shaman of the Golgari with a claim to Vraska's throne.

entities.name: Mazirek
entities.description: The kraul leader and Vraska's right-hand bug, revealed by Vraska as a Bolas collaborator and since killed.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker of the Gatewatch with one good eye who leads planeswalkers evacuating civilians and is rescued through the sewers.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A planeswalker among those pinned down in the chapel and rescued.

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: A planeswalker who owns the shape-changing dog Mowu and is rescued from the chapel.

entities.name: Mowu
entities.description: Jiang Yanggu's three-tailed dog that shrinks and grows to his height.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A planeswalker who is the last to drop down from the chapel, pursued by Eternals.

entities.name: Khazi
entities.description: A planeswalker harvested when an Eternal grabbed her through the chapel wall.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker whose Dreadhorde invades Ravnica and who is turning the Multiverse into a grave.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon guildmaster of the Izzet who left Ral a plan to save Ravnica.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: The Azorius guildmaster who collaborates with Bolas.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The mysterious shapeshifting guildmaster of House Dimir.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: The Amonkhet god leading Eternals toward the Senate House.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Nissa goes to join.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker from Skalla whose world was devastated by Bolas.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A planeswalker from Amonkhet whose world was devastated by Bolas.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: A former guildmaster turned to stone by Vraska, like those in the Statuary.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The founder of Selesnya whose will Trostani voices.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya World-Tree, awakened by Nissa and then devastated by Bolas's creatures; it ended up in Tenth District Plaza.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The nature-and-harmony guild of Ravnica, fortified and led by Emmara Tandris and Trostani.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The wild clans of Ravnica led by Borborygmos and Gan Shokta.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild of decay and growth whose throne Vraska reclaims.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild led by Kaya.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of Ral Zarek and Niv-Mizzet that names its projects.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The guild of Hekara, led by Guildmaster Rakdos.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild of Dovin Baan.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The secretive guild led by Lazav.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers to which Ajani Goldmane belongs.

entities.name: Krunstraz
entities.description: The kraul warriors garrisoning Pevnar.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's army of undead Eternals invading Ravnica.

entities.name: Operation Desperation
entities.description: Ral Zarek's plan, passed down from Niv-Mizzet, to save Ravnica that needs all ten guilds cooperating.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane under attack by Bolas's Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A world devastated by Bolas, home of Samut and the Eternals invading Ravnica.

entities.name: Skalla
entities.description: Vivien Reid's world, completely dead.

entities.name: Gobakhan
entities.description: The desert world Teyo is from.

entities.name: Skarrg
entities.description: The Gruul's immense underground playground, the cratered remains of an ancient palace.

entities.name: Korozda
entities.description: The Golgari maze of concentric circles leading to Svogthos.

entities.name: Svogthos
entities.description: The subterranean Golgari guildhall, once an Orzhov cathedral.

entities.name: Statuary
entities.description: The chamber in Svogthos lined with statues of Vraska's petrified victims.

entities.name: Pevnar
entities.description: An upside-down fortress garrisoned by the Krunstraz.

entities.name: Beacon
entities.description: Bolas's summons that drew planeswalkers to Ravnica, drained by Ral Zarek.

entities.name: Accumulator
entities.description: The device Ral Zarek wears on his back to store energy.

events.summary: Zarek and Beleren task Kaya with bringing the Golgari, Rakdos, Gruul and Selesnya to the table for Operation Desperation, and Rat offers to help.
events.quote: But Master Zarek and Mister Beleren tasked Mistress Kaya with bringing the other four wayward guilds

events.summary: Rat leads Kaya, Teyo and Nissa through secret routes past the Eternals on the way to Selesnya.
events.quote: I know most of the secret routes through Ravnica

events.summary: Teyo shields the group while Nissa asks an old birch tree to kill a crop of Eternals.
events.quote: Teyo put up a shield, and from behind it, Miss Revane asked permission of an old birch tree

events.summary: The group finds the Selesnya Conclave fortified and hostile, with Nissa blamed for awakening Vitu-Ghazi.
events.quote: We found the Conclave well and truly fortified. And unwelcoming.

events.summary: Rat slips inside and meets her godfather Boruvo, who is moved to help.
events.quote: my godfather, Keeper of my Life Pledge, the Selesnyan spearmaster Boruvo

events.summary: Boruvo carries Rat to her friends and through the Ledev line, and demands that Nissa be sent away; Nissa leaves to join Gideon.
events.quote: I've never been very good at talking. You two go with the centaur. I'll join Gideon.

events.summary: Kaya realizes Rat is invisible to Nissa and nearly everyone, and Rat explains that she is insignificant by birth magic.
events.quote: I'm not invisible. I'm insignificant . A rat.

events.summary: Emmara Tandris meets Kaya in the presence of the dormant dryad Trostani, and refuses to commit Selesnya because Ral's plans have been disasters.
events.quote: So far, every one has been an unmitigated disaster for the guilds, for Ravnica, and especially for Selesnya.

events.summary: Kaya tells Emmara the plan is called Operation Desperation and argues Bolas must be defeated.
events.quote: Operation Desperation.

events.summary: Mistress Cim awakes and persuades Mistress Ses to restore Trostani's harmony, and Selesnya joins the other guilds against Bolas.
events.quote: It is the will of Mat'Selesnya that the Conclave join the other guilds to defeat Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Ral succeeds in shutting down the Beacon, which Kaya and Teyo sense.
events.quote: Ral must have succeeded in shutting down the Beacon.

events.summary: Rat leads Kaya and Teyo through the sewers, picking a lock, to Skarrg, where Gan Shokta and Borborygmos are fighting.
events.quote: Gan Shokta was fighting with the cyclops Borborygmos

events.summary: Rat fetches her mother Ari Shokta and tells her Hekara is dead.
events.quote: But Ari . . . Hekara's dead.

events.summary: Gan Shokta and Ari show Gan that Rat is present and Rat urges them and Borborygmos to unite the Clans.
events.quote: You must unite the Clans and help the other guilds.

events.summary: Rat whispers to Borborygmos and kisses his cheek, winning the Gruul over.
events.quote: I cupped my hands and whispered again. Then I kissed his cheek.

events.summary: Kaya ghosts through Ral and aims his face at Rat so he can see her; Rat explains she tracked him for Hekara.
events.quote: From behind, Mistress Kaya literally grabbed his face in both of her once-again-solidified hands and aimed it at, well . . . me.

events.summary: The group enters Korozda unopposed and Storrev welcomes them to Svogthos, with Rat whispering her name to Ral.
events.quote: The Golgari Swarm welcomes you to Svogthos.

events.summary: Azdomas says Mazirek was a Bolas collaborator revealed by Vraska and has paid the ultimate price.
events.quote: Mazirek was another Bolas collaborator, revealed by Queen Vraska before her departure.

events.summary: Vraska planeswalks in to claim her throne and the Golgari leaders bow to her without challenge.
events.quote: Madame Storrev, Mister Azdomas, Mister Varolz, and Miss Cevraya all bowed immediately, saying in unison, "No, my queen."

events.summary: Zarek mocks Vraska's pirate look, and Kaya and Zarek challenge her about returning to Ravnica.
events.quote: What are you supposed to be, a pirate?

events.summary: Rat urges Kaya to give Vraska the benefit of the doubt, and Kaya and Zarek accept Vraska's offer to help.
events.quote: Then Mistress Kaya sighed heavily and turned to Queen Vraska to accept her help.

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane, pinned down in an old chapel by Eternals, calls up through the grate and reports that Khazi was harvested.
events.quote: Khazi was harvested when an Eternal punched its hand right through the wall and grabbed her by the wrist.

events.summary: Ajani and Vraska introduce themselves; Vraska promises the Golgari will keep the civilians safe.
events.quote: Welcome to Golgari territory, Ajani Goldmane. You are safe here.

events.summary: Ravnican children and planeswalkers Mu Yanling, Jiang Yanggu and Huatli are lowered to safety through the grate.
events.quote: Miss Mu Yanling and Mister Jiang Yanggu

events.summary: Vraska turns three pursuing Eternals to stone, sealing the hole behind the last evacuees.
events.quote: Queen Vraska locked eyes with each of them in turn, transforming all three to stone.

events.summary: Vraska reports that the Golgari are opening pathways to safety across the city, winning back a little of Zarek's trust.
events.quote: We are fighting Bolas's army and preserving life.

relations.note: He is her godfather and Keeper of her Life Pledge.
relations.quote: my godfather, Keeper of my Life Pledge
My mother has a real bear of a bear hug, but I love it.

relations.note: He is a Selesnya spearmaster who left the Gruul about ten years ago.
relations.quote: he'd found a calling with Selesnya and had switched guilds about ten years ago
elven champion and acting guildmaster of Selesnya
you know Guildmaster Kaya of the Orzhov Syndicate

relations.note: She reclaims the throne and is acknowledged as queen.
relations.quote: Does anyone challenge my right to that throne?

relations.note: The Azorius guildmaster collaborates with the dragon.
Fellow guildmasters working together for Operation Desperation.
relations.quote: Kaya forced him to begrudgingly accept, as well.

relations.note: Hekara was a loyal friend who could see her.
relations.quote: She was such a loyal friend, right?

relations.note: Zarek and Kaya see Vraska as a gorgon who betrayed them, and are ready to attack her.
relations.quote: Both were as ready as they were going to get to face the gorgon who'd betrayed them.

relations.note: Ajani introduces himself as of the Gatewatch.
relations.quote: I am Ajani Goldmane of the Gatewatch.
expanding into the three-tailed dog, as tall as its master
